column2: Fixed in dd63e7c — `applyRepoEnv` now matches the launcher path against `LAUNCHER_REL_PATHS` and steps up `matchedRel.split("/").length` times, so the repo root is derived correctly for both the shallow (`sap-adt-mcp-launcher/src/main.ts`) and the `tools/sap-adt-mcp-launcher/src/main.ts` layouts. The previous logic stopped one segment short under the `tools/...` layout and exported `OPENADT_HOME`/`OPENADT_REPO` as `…/tools`.

Fixed in dd63e7c — added `firstSubcommandIndex` and the MCP short-circuit now slices `args.slice(mcpIndex + 1)`, so leading flags (`--profile=sso`, `--`, etc.) are skipped correctly. Verified with `bun scripts/nx-openadt.ts --profile=sso mcp status --port 2257` (now routes to the launcher instead of `findDevJar`).

Fixed in dd63e7c — the MCP short-circuit is now placed before `const jar = findDevJar()`, so MCP invocations no longer require `apps/openadt-cli/target` to exist. Verified with `bun scripts/nx-openadt.ts mcp --help` in a clean tree.
